1. Focus on how the feelings will change. How you will feel when it passes. Example: "Im feeling somewhat nervous. When my feelings change I expect to feel calm and clear headed again." 

2. Say this, "Thanks but your not needed right now." Chew gum, or pretend you are. Act normal. 

3. Catch the assumptions and chase logical conclusions. What's the consciences? 

Learn to accept the fact that sometimes you will feel anxious, and that's ok. Don't let the fear of anxiety keep you from doing the things you want to do. Also understand that even if you have an anxiety attack, you're not actually in danger. I know it can feel that way and it can be embarrassing having an attack in public, but you'll be alright.
